end.summary:
Pihu identified earthworms as animals found in moist soil.
Pihu practised explaining that earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil.
Pihu repeatedly mixed up earthworms as harmful pests that spoil soil or eat crops.
Pihu did not yet explain how soil animals turn dead leaves into rich soil.
end.parentNote: Pihu practised describing where earthworms live and how their tunnels can let air and water into soil. Pihu used the idea of tunnels making soil soft, but the mix-up that earthworms spoil soil and should be killed was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask Pihu to draw an earthworm tunnel and label the air and water entering the soil.
